profile.headline: Senior Solutions Architect with over 20 years experience changing the wheels on the bus while it’s moving
profile.summary: I’m a versatile and highly analytical thinker who can effectively communicate with developers, engineers, and management specialists across multiple disciplines to develop a vision and deliver modern technology solutions that don’t just improve an organization, but transform it. I’m an experienced data and system architect, database designer, and full-stack developer with a focus on model-driven design. I’ve designed and developed scalable, flexible, and innovative solutions for law enforcement, energy management, budgeting and financial systems, and document management. I regularly participate in proposal responses, developing technical solutions, writing technical approach sections, and presenting at orals, both live and FEDSIM video orals.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Accenture CIO Patterns & Practices Lead Architect
Lead the evolution of enterprise engineering enablement from traditional developer accelerators to agentic, AI-driven software delivery. Drive the strategy and development of reusable AI-powered tools and plugins that automate software development lifecycle activities, including project bootstrapping, framework upgrades, vulnerability remediation, and code quality improvement. Establish standards for product quality, repeatability, automated testing, and defensible validation, while translating organizational OKRs into outcome-focused roadmaps and actionable development backlogs.

Lead the application of AI agents to modernize enterprise developer knowledge and self-service support, transforming a 5,200-page internal documentation ecosystem into structured, user-focused guidance without disrupting existing content ownership or access controls. Develop content organization strategies, task-oriented documentation journeys that unify guidance across teams, and AI-driven search and support capabilities to improve discoverability and developer self-sufficiency.

Maintain and evolve shared application scaffolding and CI/CD pipeline templates while advancing reusable engineering practices that accelerate delivery, improve software quality, and scale across an organization of 7,000 developers supporting more than 450 applications.

positions.title: Senior Solutions Architect
positions.description:
Head of Pyramid Labs, a corporate-sponsored research and development (R&D) unit focused on prototyping innovative solutions leveraging new and emerging technologies. Pyramid Labs has a dedicated team of hands on engineers specializing in full-stack software development, DevSecOps, security, data engineering, and analytics. 
Senior Solutions Architect and Technical Lead supporting numerous client delivery projects implementing DevOps in AWS Cloud as well as cloud.gov.
Full-Stack Developer participating in successful technical challenge proposal responses.

positions.title: Senior Solutions Architect
positions.description:
Senior Solutions Architect in the Office of the Chief Technology Officer, building the connective tissue between technology silos of a global-scale, leading provider of engineering and technology solutions to federal defense and civilian customers.
Represented division at HII-wide Technology Council, a forum for collaboration and exchange in cutting-edge technologies, such as machine learning and data science and industrial IoT.
Designed a development baseline methodology and toolset to enable turnkey project initiation to support more efficient project transitions.
Applied years of federal IT experience, deep technical expertise, and understanding of current and emerging technologies to design and develop compelling, realistic technical solutions for proposals of over $25.
Designed and developed applications for customer demonstrations to support the Business Development staff.
Designed an Agile-fluency based approach for USPS to mature software development teams from “doing Agile” to “being agile”.
Developed innovation transformation model and review process for growing ideas from ideation through experimentation and delivery.
Developed strategy and approach for addressing shadow IT. 
Launched and authored well-regarded internal technology newsletter to highlight new technologies and cutting-edge projects.

positions.title: Solutions Architect
positions.description:
Solutions Architect in the CTO organization. Responsibilities include: assessing new software technologies and methodologies; designing software architectures and implementation approaches for customer projects and overseeing subsequent development; designing solutions for proposals and writing technical volumes for proposal responses; designing and developing internal software projects; designing and developing proof-of-concept projects to assess new technologies and new software. 

Designer and developer on award-winning mobile-ready desktop application built using modern open source technologies (Electron, Node, Knockout, and SQLite). The application communicates with a centralized system on demand, allowing users to work on tablets and laptops in field environments while disconnected from the network. 

Architect for large re-engineering effort for a major law enforcement agency. Performed business and technology analysis; developed domain model, system architecture, and database architecture; developed proof-of-concept spikes for new technologies; designed and documented roadmap for a gradual transition to new architecture, including necessary data migration approaches.

Designed and developed unstructured text search application for in-house use using NodeJS, Solr, and Azure Document DB. The search application features full-text search with wildcards, stemming, and results scoring.

Architect and lead developer managing the redesign and daily operations and maintenance for a large, high-profile DoS intranet application. Applied project management policies and standard processes to improve results; worked with closely with end user representatives to ensure all business needs were adequately represented and supported; authored system architecture for .Net and PL/SQL code base; performed planning and estimating projects for future enhancements.

positions.title: Solution Architect and Project Manager
positions.description:
Developed vision and strategy to support the DOE's industrial energy management program. Collaborated with academics and engineers to design calculators, scorecards, and assessment tools. Mentored junior engineer in converting tool designs into software specifications and testing plans. Architected and developed detailed design for integrated software toolkit to deliver resources as SharePoint components, downloadable tools, mobile applications, and custom Excel Add-ins. Led team of six software developers in developing individual tools, calculators, and scorecards in .NET and Java.

Led team of developers and business analysts implementing process modernization program for the Federal Energy Management Program. Designed new system architecture and data upgrade methodology. Developed detailed recommendations for remediation and enhancements to underlying business processes.

Led team of 10 developers to produce a sophisticated system for NOAA for agency-wide planning, programming, budgeting and execution system (PPBES) in a short period of time. Prepared and ran user focus groups to refine the system requirements. Designed system and database architecture, and developed dynamic data layer using PL/SQL and XML.

Designed streamlined data structure to support DOE’s environmental remediation project tracking system. Designed data validation, transformation and migration methodology. Oversaw team of 13 database developers refactoring all existing application code, stored procedures, and migration processes.

Designed database structures in SQL Server and Oracle for an EVM reporting system, a custom CRM tool, and a database to support a computational linguistics algorithm for computing phonetic similarity. Coordinated and oversaw the design, development, and debugging activities of teams of up to 6 junior database developers. Conducted performance analysis and tuning. Rewrote a mission- critical data migration process and reduced operating time from 24 hours to 1 hour.

positions.title: Database Developer
positions.description:
Managed development project teams of up to 5 people. Performed requirements development and risk assessments. Authored ER diagrams and wrote stored procedures, indexes, and triggers in SQL Server and Oracle. Analyzed and defined data migration processes for numerous data migration projects.
Performed database optimization and performance-tuning. Achieved Microsoft Certified Database Administrator (MCDBA) certification.

positions.title: Database Analyst/Developer
positions.description: Database analyst supporting first the construction engineering office on an RF system installation project and later as internal staff supporting the accounting department.

positions.title: Third Engineer
positions.description: Third engineer on various M.E.B.A. vessels
